svg.title: kill-history: 545 to 551 failed starts in the outage, 44 to 51 after the restart
svg.desc: A lane a raun of faults/catalog.yaml's kill-history; across, seconds from the kill, the raun's inject_at. Each lane's bars are the raun's windows, left to right, each holding its failed client starts: during, from the signal landing to the hold's end; drain, from the restart to the after window; after. The dashed line is the restart, remove_at; the first tick the signal landing, the diamond history's own "initial shards ready", the second tick the signal recovered. Shards back 0.5 to 0.6 s after the restart, the signal 5 to 10 s after it, the drain 35 to 40 s long. The 60 s before window, read before the kill, failed 0. Under each lane, its failed starts a second: every failed iteration in the raun's Omes log, by its second from the restart, floored, a bar a second, the tallest 20. From the restart on, 44 to 51 failed, the last 4 to 11 s after it. Sources: docs/tables/fig-kill-history.jsonl, docs/tables/rauns.jsonl, docs/tables/src/hosts.tsv.
